title: Slab-to-Spot Optimizer & Hiring Swap Simulator (Sep 2026)
summary: Compact scenario workbook to evaluate short-term cost and runway impacts of shifting a portion of reserved slab GPU capacity to spot/ephemeral capacity, paired with a hiring-swap (contractor -> perm) proposal to reduce fixed burn. Includes per-scenario token unit cost, SLA risk proxy, and headcount rebalancing outcomes.
primary_objective: Find near-term levers to extend runway by 9-18 months under three price-shock cases while preserving 95th-pct latency SLAs for hosted customers.
assumptions: Baseline reserved slab commit = $1.2M/month (mix of A100/RTX equivalent)
Spot capacity can serve up to 40% of peak throughput with a 10-25% preemption risk depending on region
Contractor to perm swap reduces near-term cash burn by 12% over 6 months but increases fixed OPEX long-term
Average token mix: 60% generation, 40% embeddings/rerank -> different per-token costs
Model mix: 70% medium (7B-13B), 30% large (30B+); quantization path available for medium tier
Buffer credit (burst reserve) of 10% capacity maintained for SLA-sensitive traffic
headcount_plan_rows: Infra SWE,28,Swap 6 SWE to contractors (-6 perm, +6 contractors),Saves 6*120k annualized comp over 12 months but introduces ramp risk
SRE,12,No swap,Maintain stability during spot usage ramp
Cost Ops,4,Swap 1 perm to contractor,Lower immediate headcount fixed cost by 8%
Solutions Eng,10,Swap 2 perm to contractors,Target non-core customer onboarding tasks
pricing_sensitivity_rows: Scenario,Spot Discount vs Reserved,Spot Availability,Monthly Burn Delta,Runway Delta (months),Unit Token Cost Delta,SLA Risk Proxy
Price Shock (+30% GPU cost),effective spot discount reduces by 10 percentage points,availability down 10 pts,Burn Delta reduced by ~30%,Runway impact -1.0 months,SLA Risk up
model_mix_adjustments: Quantize medium-models (7B-13B) -> 8-12% token cost reduction,small quality delta for deterministic tasks
Auto-fallback: route SLA-critical 10% of traffic to reserved slab during preemption window
Batching tuning: increase batch window from 20ms to 40ms for background workloads -> cost savings and slight latency tradeoffs
key_metrics: Net runway (months) at current burn vs optimized burn
Average unit cost per 1k tokens across scenarios
Percent of traffic in SLA-safe reserve during peak
Projected churn risk from latency degradation (qualitative scoring)
simulation_outputs_summary: Base case: move 30% of baseline throughput to spot, swap 8 perm roles to contractors -> immediate monthly burn down by $265k, runway +4.1 months, unit cost -1.2¢
Conservative case: move 15% to spot, swap 4 roles -> burn -$110k, runway +1.8 months, SLA risk manageable with 12% reserve
Aggressive case: move 50% to spot, swap 12 roles -> burn -$540k, runway +9.5 months but SLA proxy shows elevated risk during multi-region outages
recommended_action: Pilot: 8-week pilot in us-west region moving 25-30% non-critical throughput to spot with SRE playbook and 12% reserved buffer
Hiring swap: execute 6-role contractor conversion (target infra and cost-ops) with 6-month review and retention incentives for critical roles
Instrumentation: add token-level SLA labeling and cost breakdown for spot-served requests
Contingency: maintain pre-paid burst credits equal to 15% of peak to absorb transient spot loss
financial_notes: CAPEX vs OPEX: spot reduces monthly cash outflow but increases operational toil and potential increased long-term vendor spend if quality regressions occur
Tax/treatment: contractor swap impacts benefits accrual and payroll tax; run through payroll/finance for FY26 adjustments
Sensitivity: GPU price shock neutralizes ~30-50% of spot benefit in worst-case; keep price-hedge tranche in the commitment schedule
next_steps: Align with Platform Eng on pilot runbook and canary routing rules (owner: Oliver Chen)
Prepare contractor conversion offer templates and 6-month retention clauses (owner: People Ops)
Create monitoring dashboard slices in Console for spot-routed requests and latency percentiles (owner: Observability team PR)
Re-run workbook with updated Sept cloud spot pricing on 2026-09-25 and circulate to execs
notes_to_modeling: Add stochastic preemption model (Poisson) with regional covariates
Measure quality delta for quantized medium models on 5 canonical prompt sets
Tie cost outputs to customer cohorts (top 10 customers by revenue) to measure revenue-at-risk
freeform_notes: Working doc: use this as the canonical short-term cost/playbook. Many estimates from cloud vendor quotes and infra telemetry. Open questions: contractor ramp time assumptions, true customer latency tolerance distribution, and tax treatment of contractor swaps in EMEA.
conclusion: A modest slab->spot shift paired with tactical hiring swaps can materially extend runway (4–9 months depending on aggressiveness) with acceptable SLA risk when protected by a small reserved buffer and active monitoring. Recommend pilot next steps before wider rollout.
